## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `develop` and merging back into `develop`
- [ ] Latest `develop` merged or rebased in, conflicts resolved
- [ ] Under 25 changed files (split the PR if not)
- [ ] Commit messages follow the project's format
- [ ] `swiftformat RecipeTest Tests UITests --lint` passes
- [ ] SwiftLint clean (runs as a build tool plugin)
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated, and the suite passes
- [ ] Both `RecipeTest` and `RecipeTest-Staging` schemes build
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or debug logging left in the diff
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff before requesting review
